title: Physics Momentum Lab: Elastic Collision Simulator
description: An interactive physics education lab where CesiumMan and Michelle stand on frictionless sliders representing two bodies in a 1D elastic collision. Students assign mass and velocity to each character, launch the collision, observe momentum and kinetic energy conservation in real-time gauges, then use undo/redo to explore how changing parameters affects outcomes.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load CesiumMan.glb and Michelle.glb as two collision bodies standing on flat platform sliders along the X-axis. Setup: PerspectiveCamera at (0,3,10) looking at origin; ambient light 0.5 intensity plus directional light from (5,10,7). Draw a ground plane with grid lines representing a frictionless track. Place CesiumMan at x=-5 and Michelle at x=5, both playing their idle animations via AnimationMixer. UI Requirements (HTML overlay): For each character show labeled sliders for mass (1-10 kg) and initial velocity (-5 to +5 m/s). Display real-time readouts for total momentum (p=m1*v1+m2*v2) and total kinetic energy (KE=0.5*m1*v1^2+0.5*m2*v2^2) both before and after collision. Add buttons: 'Launch', 'Reset', 'Undo', 'Redo'. Interaction Steps (10-14): (1) Adjust CesiumMan mass, (2) adjust CesiumMan velocity, (3) adjust Michelle mass, (4) adjust Michelle velocity, (5) observe pre-collision conservation gauges update, (6) press Launch to animate both characters sliding toward each other, (7) on contact trigger elastic collision math to compute post-collision velocities using conservation of momentum and kinetic energy equations, (8) animate characters sliding apart at new velocities, (9) verify post-collision gauges match pre-collision totals, (10) press Undo to revert last parameter change, (11) press Redo to restore it, (12) modify a parameter and re-launch to compare outcomes. Physics: implement exact 1D elastic collision formulas v1f=(m1-m2)/(m1+m2)*v1i+(2*m2)/(m1+m2)*v2i and similarly for v2f. During animation, translate each model along X at their respective velocities. Maintain a history stack of all parameter states for undo/redo. Color-code momentum bar green and KE bar blue. Show floating 3D text labels above each character with their current mass and velocity. Ensure both GLB models are scaled uniformly to similar heights around 1.8 units.
